event: Nala walks to the slick's lower edge and plants the spear butt in the grass.
She reaches into the black water with her tide and pushes.
It's heavier than plain water. Cold, and leaning downhill like a tide that wants to come in.

memory.fact: Pushed by Undertow, the slick feels heavier than plain water, cold, leaning downhill like a tide.
Pushed by Undertow, the slick feels heavier than plain water, cold, leaning downhill like a tide.

event: Her well leans toward it too, the way it did at the Callow pool.

memory.fact: Pulled into her, slick water sinks into Nala's well like the Sea's own, cold, and does no harm.

event: She leans back. Slowly the black thread draws back up the grass, into the slick.
The slick's lower edge lifts and begins to roll uphill, crust cracking as it goes.
It fights her every pace. Twice it surges back and she has to take the ground again.

memory.fact: Once Nala lets go, the slick creeps back down at its old few paces a day, unless something holds it.
Once Nala lets go, the slick creeps back down at its old few paces a day, unless something holds it.

event: It's plain work, like towing, but slow. The sun slides west across the Whitecombs.

memory.fact: Pushing the slick is plain towing work, and wears Nala's mind no more than towing does.
Pushing the slick is plain towing work, and wears Nala's mind no more than towing does.

event: Close to two hours on, the whole slick is heaped black in the narrow gully mouth.

changes.note: Two hours of leaning her tide against the slick
Rolling the whole slick back up the pasture into the gully mouth

memory.fact: Nala's push can roll the whole slick back up the pasture into the gully mouth in close to two hours.
Nala's push can roll the whole slick back up the pasture into the gully mouth in close to two hours.
Late on day twenty-seven, Nala has pushed the whole black slick back into the gully mouth.
Late on day twenty-seven, Nala has pushed the whole black slick back into the gully mouth.

event: The pasture below lies grey with salt, steaming faintly, the six carcasses still on it.

memory.fact: Cleared of the slick, the high pasture lies grey with salt, steaming faintly, six carcasses on it.
Cleared of the slick, the high pasture lies grey with salt, steaming faintly, six carcasses on it.

event: Nala eases off, breathing deep through her refined lungs.
At once the black water at the gully mouth leans down again. A finger's width. Then two.

memory.fact: The bank holds; with the pool's trickle behind it, the slick will top it in about three weeks.

event: Ebba stands at the longhouse door with a bundle on her back, watching.
Ebba: "That gully's narrow. A bank of peat and stones would hold it, I'd think."

memory.fact: The gully mouth above the pasture is narrow; a bank of peat and stones there would hold the slick.
The gully mouth above the pasture is narrow; a bank of peat and stones there would hold the slick.

event: Ebba: "But the sun's low, and I'll not have the boys on the mountain after dark."

memory.fact: Ebba will not have her grandsons on the mountain after dark.
Ebba will not have her grandsons on the mountain after dark.

event: Hawise: "Bank it now, or get them down first? Your call."
